profile.headline: Lead Technical Consultant at Full Visibility LLC
profile.summary:
Software engineer with an active TS/SCI and CI Poly, currently driving technical execution and team coordination on federal government projects. I work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment between business needs and technical delivery.

Pursuing my MBA at Texas A&M (Class of ’26 – Whoop!) to expand my expertise in strategic leadership, operations, and organizational management. With a background in C# (.NET), JavaScript, and modern frameworks, I bring a product-minded approach to software development, balancing deep technical insight with a strong focus on mission impact.

My goal is to grow into senior leadership roles where I can lead digital transformation efforts across government and industry by combining technical fluency with business strategy.

positions.title: Intelligence Analyst TS/SCI
positions.description:
Intelligence Supervisor, USARCENT, Shaw AFB, SC	    2015-2017
●Managed 20 military intelligence specialists who provided timely and accurate information to the Commanding General
●Review and synthesize data and reports from the intelligence community to prepare weekly intelligence summaries for USARCENT senior ranking personnel
●Deliver briefings that permit senior staff to quickly grasp the essentials of complex and ambiguous situations, enabling them to adapt operational plans in order to take advantage of rapidly-changing circumstances
Intelligence Analyst, Joint Task Force, Iraq	  2016-2017
●Built intelligence collection focuses to drive the questioning of 175 interrogations and provided analytical research for each tactical interrogation report that supported ongoing combat operations and greater dissemination
●Logistically supported inner agency meetings between the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and Department of State (DOS) by route and convoy management to the U.S. Consulate in Erbil, IZ
●Managed a collection platform during transition period of team leaders
●In-processed and tracked captured enemy material coming out of Operation Inherent Resolve 
Tactical Intelligence Analyst, Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA	2012-2015
●Reviewed and data mined raw intelligence from the Intelligence Community in order to provide battlefield updates to senior officer
●Conducted initial preparation of the battlefield by analyzing environmental and economic considerations in order to prepare the senior officer to make decisions
●Trained as an analyst for Company Intelligence-Support team (CoIST)
●Created tactical graphical intelligence summary for senior officer 
●Trained on Biometric Automated Toolset (BATS)
